Proxy with username and password credentials authenticates successfully

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { crawl, createEngine } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { proxy: { password: "proxypass", url: "http://127.0.0.1:8889", username: "proxyuser" }, respectRobotsTxt: false };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await crawl(engine, url);
  console.log(result.pages?.length);
}

void main();
```
